purpose: y2s76-thumbfix2: Nord2Metal = y2s73-thumbfix + in MobileSlideShow a YCbCr surface converted to RGB is not converted again (the texture keeps the picture it was made from). Run thumbdiag: Photos' cell textures are made over pool pixel buffers (10+ textures over surface 67); the pool reuses a buffer while those textures exist (this port's IOSurface use count is a no-op) and every texture over it was re-converted from the new contents at the next use (474e64 -> 080508 at n=16): the grid went black. Elsewhere surfaces are followed as before; /var/db/nord2-metal/photos-ycbcr-live restores following in MobileSlideShow. All on the GPU. Installs over thumbdiag, thumbfix or vt23 (kept as Nord2Metal.pre-thumbfix2).
